"""Castellano custom format and quality profile for Radarr and Sonarr.

What TRaSH does not cover (no Spanish CFs in the guides) and recyclarr
cannot define (trash_ids only) lives here instead. Idempotent.
"""

import json
import os
import urllib.request

CF_NAME = "Castellano"
PROFILE_NAME = "Castellano"
SCORE = 10000
QUALITIES = ["HDTV-1080p", "WEBRip-1080p", "WEBDL-1080p", "Bluray-1080p"]
CUTOFF = "Bluray-1080p"

# All three must hold: spanish audio named, and neither latino nor VOSE.
SPECIFICATIONS = [
    {
        "name": "Castellano en el titulo",
        "implementation": "ReleaseTitleSpecification",
        "negate": False,
        "required": True,
        "fields": [{"name": "value", "value": "(?i)\\b(castellano|español|espanol|spanish|esp)\\b"}],
    },
    {
        "name": "Sin latino",
        "implementation": "ReleaseTitleSpecification",
        "negate": True,
        "required": True,
        "fields": [{"name": "value", "value": "(?i)\\b(latino|lat)\\b"}],
    },
    {
        "name": "Sin VOSE",
        "implementation": "ReleaseTitleSpecification",
        "negate": True,
        "required": True,
        "fields": [{"name": "value", "value": "(?i)\\bvose?\\b"}],
    },
]


def api(base, key, method, path, body=None):
    data = json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        f"{base}/api/v3/{path}",
        data=data,
        method=method,
        headers={"X-Api-Key": key, "Content-Type": "application/json"},
    )
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as resp:
        raw = resp.read()
    return json.loads(raw) if raw else None


def ensure_custom_format(base, key):
    payload = {
        "name": CF_NAME,
        "includeCustomFormatWhenRenaming": False,
        "specifications": SPECIFICATIONS,
    }
    cfs = api(base, key, "GET", "customformat")
    existing = next((c for c in cfs if c["name"] == CF_NAME), None)
    if existing:
        payload["id"] = existing["id"]
        api(base, key, "PUT", f"customformat/{existing['id']}", payload)
        return "updated"
    api(base, key, "POST", "customformat", payload)
    return "created"


def item_names(item):
    if item.get("quality"):
        return [item["quality"]["name"]]
    return [i["quality"]["name"] for i in item.get("items", [])]


def ensure_profile(base, key):
    profiles = api(base, key, "GET", "qualityprofile")
    existing = next((p for p in profiles if p["name"] == PROFILE_NAME), None)
    if existing:
        existing["minFormatScore"] = SCORE
        existing["cutoffFormatScore"] = SCORE
        for fi in existing["formatItems"]:
            if fi["name"] == CF_NAME:
                fi["score"] = SCORE
        api(base, key, "PUT", f"qualityprofile/{existing['id']}", existing)
        return "updated"

    profile = api(base, key, "GET", "qualityprofile/schema")
    profile["name"] = PROFILE_NAME
    profile["upgradeAllowed"] = True
    profile["minFormatScore"] = SCORE
    profile["cutoffFormatScore"] = SCORE
    for item in profile["items"]:
        item["allowed"] = any(n in QUALITIES for n in item_names(item))
        for sub in item.get("items", []):
            sub["allowed"] = sub["quality"]["name"] in QUALITIES
        if CUTOFF in item_names(item):
            profile["cutoff"] = item["quality"]["id"] if item.get("quality") else item["id"]
    for fi in profile["formatItems"]:
        if fi["name"] == CF_NAME:
            fi["score"] = SCORE
    api(base, key, "POST", "qualityprofile", profile)
    return "created"


def main():
    for app in ("RADARR", "SONARR"):
        base = os.environ[f"{app}_URL"]
        key = os.environ[f"{app}_API_KEY"]
        print(f"{app.lower()}: custom format {ensure_custom_format(base, key)}", flush=True)
        print(f"{app.lower()}: quality profile {ensure_profile(base, key)}", flush=True)


main()

"""Watches Moonraker print jobs and mails Sean when one stops making
progress. Runs in-cluster so it survives the workstation being off."""
import json
import os
import smtplib
import time
import urllib.request
from email.message import EmailMessage

URLS = [u.strip().rstrip("/") for u in os.environ["MOONRAKER_URLS"].split(",") if u.strip()]
SMTP_HOST = os.environ["SMTP_HOST"]
SMTP_PORT = int(os.environ["SMTP_PORT"])
MAIL_TO = os.environ["MAIL_TO"]
MAIL_FROM = os.environ["MAIL_FROM"]
POLL_S = int(os.environ.get("POLL_S", "20"))
STALL_S = int(os.environ.get("STALL_S", "300"))
AUTO_RESUME = os.environ.get("AUTO_RESUME", "false").lower() == "true"
RESUME_GRACE_S = int(os.environ.get("RESUME_GRACE_S", "60"))
MAX_RESUMES = int(os.environ.get("MAX_RESUMES", "3"))

QUERY = "print_stats&virtual_sdcard&extruder&heater_bed"
TERMINAL = {"complete", "cancelled", "error", "standby"}


def log(msg):
    print(f"{time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}  {msg}", flush=True)


def get(url, path, timeout=10):
    with urllib.request.urlopen(f"{url}{path}", timeout=timeout) as r:
        return json.load(r)


def post(url, path, timeout=30):
    req = urllib.request.Request(f"{url}{path}", method="POST", data=b"")
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as r:
        return json.load(r)


def mail(subject, body):
    try:
        m = EmailMessage()
        m["Subject"], m["From"], m["To"] = subject, MAIL_FROM, MAIL_TO
        m.set_content(body)
        with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, timeout=20) as s:
            s.send_message(m)
        log(f"EMAIL SENT: {subject}")
    except Exception as exc:
        log(f"email failed ({subject}): {exc}")


def describe(url, st):
    ps, vs = st["print_stats"], st["virtual_sdcard"]
    e, b = st["extruder"], st["heater_bed"]
    return (
        f"printer  : {url}\n"
        f"file     : {ps.get('filename')}\n"
        f"state    : {ps.get('state')}\n"
        f"message  : {ps.get('message') or '(none)'}\n"
        f"progress : {vs.get('progress', 0) * 100:.2f} %\n"
        f"duration : {ps.get('print_duration', 0) / 3600:.2f} h\n"
        f"nozzle   : {e['temperature']:.1f} / {e['target']:.1f} C\n"
        f"bed      : {b['temperature']:.1f} / {b['target']:.1f} C\n"
    )


state = {u: {"last": None, "file": None, "pos": None, "moved": time.time(),
             "paused_at": None, "resumes": 0, "stalled": False} for u in URLS}

log(f"watching {URLS} every {POLL_S}s (auto_resume={AUTO_RESUME})")

while True:
    for url in URLS:
        s = state[url]
        try:
            st = get(url, f"/printer/objects/query?{QUERY}")["result"]["status"]
        except Exception as exc:
            log(f"{url} unreachable: {exc}")
            continue

        ps = st["print_stats"]
        cur, fn = ps.get("state"), ps.get("filename")
        pos = st["virtual_sdcard"].get("file_position")

        if fn != s["file"]:
            s.update(file=fn, resumes=0, stalled=False, pos=None)

        if pos != s["pos"]:
            s.update(pos=pos, moved=time.time(), stalled=False)

        if cur != s["last"]:
            log(f"{url}: {s['last']} -> {cur}")
            if cur == "paused":
                s["paused_at"] = time.time()
                mail(f"PRINT PAUSED: {fn}", describe(url, st) +
                     "\nNo resume has been attempted yet.\n")
            elif cur in ("error", "cancelled"):
                mail(f"PRINT {cur.upper()}: {fn}", describe(url, st))
            elif cur == "complete":
                mail(f"PRINT COMPLETE: {fn}", describe(url, st))
            s["last"] = cur

        if cur == "paused" and AUTO_RESUME and s["paused_at"]:
            waited = time.time() - s["paused_at"]
            klipper_error = bool(ps.get("message"))
            if klipper_error:
                pass  # a real fault; a human must look
            elif s["resumes"] >= MAX_RESUMES:
                pass
            elif waited >= RESUME_GRACE_S:
                try:
                    post(url, "/printer/print/resume")
                    s["resumes"] += 1
                    s["paused_at"] = None
                    log(f"{url}: auto-resumed ({s['resumes']}/{MAX_RESUMES})")
                    mail(f"AUTO-RESUMED: {fn}", describe(url, st) +
                         f"\nResume {s['resumes']} of {MAX_RESUMES}."
                         " Klipper reported no error, so this looked"
                         " like a spurious pause.\n")
                except Exception as exc:
                    log(f"{url}: resume failed: {exc}")

        # print_duration stays 0 for the whole START_PRINT preamble
        # (heat soak, QGL, nozzle clean, bed mesh), during which the
        # state is already "printing" but the file never advances.
        started = (ps.get("print_duration") or 0) > 0
        if cur == "printing" and started and not s["stalled"]:
            if time.time() - s["moved"] > STALL_S:
                s["stalled"] = True
                mail(f"PRINT STALLED: {fn}", describe(url, st) +
                     f"\nFile position has not advanced for {STALL_S}s"
                     " while still reporting 'printing'.\n")

        if cur in TERMINAL:
            s["paused_at"] = None

    time.sleep(POLL_S)
